pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, non-geometric dark regions with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Individual patches exhibit a dendritic or leaf-like morphology with varying spatial area, appearing more condensed and elongated on the neck and broader on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-point intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank but narrows significantly toward the extremities.
